title: 2027 Chase Leadership Development Program – Summer Analyst Opportunity in the USA
summary: The 2027 Chase Leadership Development Program (CLDP) Summer Analyst Opportunity is now open for students interested in gaining hands-on experience in financial services, business strategy, product development, project management, analytics, and emerging technology. Offered by JPMorgan Chase Co. through its Consumer Community Banking division, the program provides selected students with a 9-week summer analyst experience designed to introduce them to the Chase Leadership Development Program and prepare high-performing candidates for potential full-time opportunities after graduation. The 2027 Summer Analyst Program is available in Columbus, Ohio; Wilmington, Delaware; and Plano, Texas , giving eligible students an opportunity to gain practical corporate experience while working on projects that have a real-world impact on customers and the business. The application deadline is December 1, 2026, at 8:00 AM . However, applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, and the program may close earlier once available positions are filled. Students who meet the eligibility requirements are therefore strongly encouraged to apply as early as possible. What Is the Chase Leadership Development Program Summer Analyst Opportunity? The Chase Leadership Development Program Summer Analyst Opportunity is a summer internship experience within JPMorgan Chase s Consumer Community Banking business. The program is structured as a 9-week introduction to the full-time Chase Leadership Development Program . During the summer, analysts receive exposure to Chase s businesses and work on projects intended to provide measurable value to the organization and its customers. Rather than being limited to one narrow area of banking, the program provides exposure to a broad range of functions and business areas. These include: Auto Business Banking Card Services Connected Commerce Consumer Banking Digital Product Experience Finance Home Lending J.P. Morgan Wealth Management Marketing Controls Operations Risk Management Strategy and Strategic Initiatives Summer Analysts are placed into roles focused on one of three primary disciplines: Product Project/Program Management Strategy Strategic Initiatives This structure allows participants to develop a broader understanding of how a major financial institution develops products, manages complex projects, makes strategic decisions, evaluates risk, and serves customers. What Does a Chase Summer Analyst Do? The Summer Analyst role is designed to provide meaningful exposure to real business challenges rather than simply observational work. Participants may contribute to projects involving data, product development, strategy, marketing, operations, risk, technology, and cross-functional collaboration. Key responsibilities include: 1. Data Analytics and Business Decision-Making Summer Analysts may use data analytics to evaluate operational effectiveness and help support business decisions. This can involve: Measuring operational performance Analyzing business data Supporting risk-versus-reward decisions Assessing profitability Forecasting financial outcomes Identifying opportunities for improvement This component makes analytical ability particularly important for candidates interested in the program. 2. Product Development Participants may contribute to the development of financial products and services throughout their lifecycle. This can include: Testing new features Iterating products based on findings Measuring performance Evaluating customer response Supporting product marketing Helping develop new and emerging financial solutions Students interested in product management, technology, marketing, business development, or customer experience may find this particularly relevant. 3. Project and Program Management Analysts may also support project management efforts associated with high-visibility Chase brands and initiatives. This can include work related to: Marketing initiatives Media initiatives Business projects Cross-functional coordination Project planning Implementation Performance measurement The role therefore requires candidates who can organize information, manage priorities, collaborate with different teams, and help move projects forward. 4. Business Strategy and Regulatory Controls Summer Analysts may evaluate and quantify business strategies while taking regulatory controls into consideration. This provides exposure to the relationship between: Business strategy Financial performance Risk Regulation Operational controls Customer outcomes Students interested in strategy, finance, risk management, consulting, or financial services can gain valuable experience from this aspect of the program. 5. Cross-Functional Problem Solving The program emphasizes collaboration across different business functions. Depending on the assignment, analysts may work with teams such as: Engineering Brand Legal Compliance Finance UX Design Product Operations Strategy This provides participants with an opportunity to understand how large organizations bring together people with different technical and professional backgrounds to solve complex business problems. 6. AI-Enabled Solutions The 2027 program also highlights the use of artificial intelligence in business operations. Participants may have opportunities to: Design AI-enabled solutions Build and deploy solutions that automate workflows Improve decision-making Enhance customer and stakeholder experiences Evaluate AI models Monitor AI-enabled systems Apply responsible AI controls This makes the opportunity particularly relevant for students interested in the intersection of business, finance, analytics, technology, and artificial intelligence . Training and Professional Development One of the major features of the Chase Leadership Development Program Summer Analyst experience is its emphasis on professional development. Participants have access to structured training designed to strengthen both business knowledge and professional skills. The program provides a support network that includes: A dedicated program manager Professional mentors Senior leaders Managers Peer mentors Participants can also receive frequent feedback and coaching throughout the internship. This environment is intended to help students understand their strengths, improve their professional capabilities, develop their personal brand, and build meaningful professional relationships. Potential Pathway to a Full-Time Career The Summer Analyst Program can serve as an entry point into the broader Chase Leadership Development Program . Successful completion of the summer program may result in an offer of employment into the CLDP full-time program , which is described as a two-year rotational program . This is an important feature for students who are looking beyond a short-term internship and are interested in developing a longer-term career at JPMorgan Chase. However, completion of the summer program does not mean that every participant is automatically guaranteed a full-time position. The opportunity states that successful completion may result in an offer. Required Skills and Qualifications Candidates should demonstrate a combination of analytical ability, communication skills, professionalism, curiosity, and problem-solving ability. The required capabilities include: Analytical Skills Applicants should have exceptional analytical skills and demonstrate strong technical learning ability. Candidates should be comfortable learning new concepts and using information to understand and solve business problems. Intellectual Curiosity The program looks for students who demonstrate: Curiosity Willingness to learn Interest in understanding how businesses work Motivation to explore new ideas Microsoft Office Skills Applicants should be proficient in: Microsoft Excel Microsoft Word Microsoft PowerPoint These tools are important for analysis, documentation, presentations, and communicating business recommendations. Communication Skills Strong interpersonal and communication skills are required. Candidates should be able to communicate effectively with colleagues, managers, and other stakeholders. Teamwork and Collaboration The program operates in a highly collaborative environment, so candidates should be comfortable working as part of a team. The position specifically emphasizes being: Proactive A team player Professional Collaborative Project Management and Problem Solving Candidates should demonstrate excellent: Project management skills Problem-solving skills Collaboration skills These abilities are particularly relevant because Summer Analysts may work on projects involving multiple teams and business functions. Adaptability Applicants should be able to thrive in a dynamic and changing environment. This is important because large financial institutions operate across multiple businesses, technologies, regulatory requirements, and customer needs. Interest in Financial Innovation Candidates should have an interest in supporting innovative financial products and services. Preferred Academic Qualifications The preferred academic profile is particularly important for students considering applying. Applicants are expected to be pursuing one of the following: Bachelor of Arts (B.A.) Bachelor of Science (B.S.) Fifth-year Master of Arts (M.A.) Fifth-year Master of Science (M.S.) The expected graduation window is: December 2027 through June 2028. The opportunity also lists a: Minimum GPA of 3.2 out of 4.0. The academic fields listed as a plus include: Actuarial Science Economics Engineering Finance Mathematics Operations Research Statistics Analytics Information Systems Emerging Technology in Business The wording indicates that coursework in these areas is an advantage rather than stating that applicants must necessarily major in one of these fields. Where Is the 2027 Chase Summer Analyst Program Located? The program is offered in three U.S. locations: Columbus, Ohio Columbus is one of the locations where selected Summer Analysts can be placed. Wilmington, Delaware Wilmington is another available program location. Plano, Texas Plano, Texas is the third listed location. Applicants are required to provide a location preference as part of their application. U.S. Work Authorization Requirement An important eligibility condition is that applicants must be authorized to work in the United States . JPMorgan Chase explicitly states that it does not offer employment-based immigration sponsorship for this program . The company also states that it will not provide assistance or sign documentation supporting other forms of immigration sponsorship or benefits, including: Optional Practical Training (OPT) Curricular Practical Training (CPT) Therefore, international students who require sponsorship or related immigration assistance should carefully consider this requirement before applying. Who Can Apply for the 2027 Chase Summer Analyst Opportunity? The opportunity is primarily designed for university students who meet the academic, graduation, work authorization, and skills requirements. A strong candidate would generally be someone who: Is pursuing a B.A., B.S., fifth-year M.A., or M.S. degree Expects to graduate between December 2027 and June 2028 Has a minimum GPA of 3.2/4.0 Has strong analytical skills Is comfortable learning technical concepts Has strong communication and interpersonal skills Can work effectively in teams Has project management and problem-solving capabilities Is proficient in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint Is interested in innovative financial products and services Is authorized to work in the United States Can work in one of the listed U.S. program locations Coursework in areas such as finance, economics, analytics, mathematics, statistics, engineering, information systems, and emerging technology can be an advantage. Application Process The application process includes several stages. Step 1: Submit the Application Applicants must submit a complete application, including: Resume Location preference Relevant application information JPMorgan Chase emphasizes that applicants should complete all relevant questions carefully because the application and resume are used by the recruiting team to initially assess candidates. Step 2: Complete the Video Interview Candidates who meet the minimum application criteria will receive an invitation to complete a video interview powered by HireVue . The video interview provides candidates with an opportunity to expand on their resume and demonstrate their experience, communication skills, and suitability for the program. The HireVue interview is required. An application will not proceed to further review until the required video interview step has been completed. Step 3: Complete the Interview Promptly Applicants are strongly encouraged to complete the HireVue video interview within three days of receiving the invitation . This is particularly important because applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. Step 4: Rolling Review and Position Availability Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. The employer strongly encourages candidates to apply and complete all required application components as early as possible because the program may close when available positions are filled. Application Deadline Deadline: December 1, 2026, at 8:00 AM. However, applicants should not wait until the final deadline. Because applications are reviewed on a rolling basis and positions can close as they are filled, submitting an application early may be important. Why Consider the Chase Leadership Development Program? The program offers several features that can make it valuable for students seeking a career in financial services, technology, analytics, strategy, product management, or business leadership. 1. Real-World Business Experience Participants work on projects designed to have a real impact on Chase s business and customers. 2. Exposure to Multiple Business Areas The program provides exposure to numerous areas of a major financial services organization, from consumer banking and card services to digital products, finance, risk, operations, and strategy. 3. Professional Mentorship Participants receive support from program managers, mentors, senior leaders, managers, and peers. 4. Skills Development The program provides structured training intended to strengthen business acumen, professional capabilities, and technical skills. 5. Networking Participants can build relationships with colleagues, mentors, senior leaders, and other students participating in the program. 6. Potential Full-Time Opportunity Successful completion of the Summer Analyst Program may lead to an offer to join the two-year CLDP full-time rotational program. 7. Exposure to Emerging Technology The program includes work involving AI-enabled solutions, workflow automation, decision-making, customer experience, and responsible AI controls. Benefits and Employee Support JPMorgan Chase states that it offers a competitive total rewards package and a range of benefits for eligible employees. The broader benefits described by the organization include: Comprehensive healthcare coverage On-site health and wellness centers Retirement savings plans Backup childcare Tuition reimbursement Mental health support Financial coaching The specific compensation and benefits applicable to a particular position are provided during the hiring process and depend on eligibility. Diversity and Inclusion JPMorgan Chase states that it is committed to an inclusive work environment and values the diverse backgrounds, experiences, and skills of its workforce. The company describes itself as an equal opportunity employer and states that it does not discriminate based on protected characteristics, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy, disability, or other characteristics protected by applicable law. The company also states that reasonable accommodations are available for applicants and employees with disabilities and certain other needs. Click HERE to read more. How to Prepare a Strong Application Students interested in this opportunity should make sure their application clearly demonstrates how their background matches the program. 1. Tailor Your Resume Focus your resume on experiences demonstrating: Analytical ability Leadership Problem solving Project management Teamwork Communication Technology Business knowledge Data analysis 2. Highlight Measurable Achievements Where possible, demonstrate the impact of your work using measurable results. For example, instead of simply saying that you worked on a project, explain what you contributed and what outcome was achieved. 3. Demonstrate Your Interest in Financial Services The program is designed around financial products, services, customers, business strategy, and innovation. Candidates should be prepared to explain why they are interested in these areas. 4. Prepare for the HireVue Interview Because the video interview is a required part of the process, applicants should prepare examples demonstrating: Leadership Teamwork Problem solving Adaptability Communication Initiative Handling challenges Learning new skills 5. Apply Early Do not treat December 1, 2026, as the only date that matters. Since applications are reviewed on a rolling basis and positions may close once filled, early application is strongly recommended. APPLY HERE Conclusion The 2027 Chase Leadership Development Program Summer Analyst Opportunity provides university students with a structured nine-week introduction to one of JPMorgan Chase s leadership development pathways. Through exposure to product management, project management, strategy, analytics, financial services, technology, risk, marketing, and other business functions, participants can gain practical experience while developing their professional and technical capabilities. The program is particularly relevant for students interested in finance, business strategy, analytics, technology, product management, operations, and financial innovation . Participants can also benefit from mentorship, structured training, networking, coaching, and exposure to senior leaders. An additional advantage is the potential pathway from the summer experience into the two-year Chase Leadership Development Program , although such a full-time opportunity depends on successful completion and is not guaranteed. Students who meet the academic and work authorization requirements should pay close attention to the rolling application process. With the stated deadline of December 1, 2026, at 8:00 AM , and positions potentially closing earlier as they are filled, submitting a complete application early is strongly recommended. title: Nordic Baltic Youth Summit 2026 in Tallinn, Estonia: Applications Open for 200 Young Changemakers
summary: The Nordic Baltic Youth Summit 2026 is inviting young changemakers from across the Nordic and Baltic region to apply for a unique youth leadership and policy-making opportunity in Tallinn, Estonia . The summit will bring together 200 young people to exchange ideas, engage in meaningful discussions, explore major challenges affecting young people and society, and develop policy recommendations for national decision-makers . Participants will have the opportunity to connect with other young leaders, challenge their perspectives and contribute their ideas to discussions on artificial intelligence, security, mental health, democracy and radicalisation.
